name: AMD Radeon 890M
memory_note: Strix Point APU (RDNA 3.5): GPU memory is system RAM through GTT, half of RAM by default (15.08 GiB on a 32 GB laptop). loom-serve must stay inside the GTT: the per-model --memory_bytes is in fleet/devices/gfx1150.json serve_args (14e9 on 32 GB). No budget: the pool is sized to MemTotal and a long request fails on the device once the GTT is full

host_setup.text: Stock Ubuntu limits locked memory to 8 MiB, and loom-serve then fails every weight load after it reports ready (`buffer pin preparation failed`). Raise the limit once, then log out and back in; `ulimit -l` must print `unlimited`:
host_setup.note: For services started by systemd also set DefaultLimitMEMLOCK=infinity in /etc/systemd/system.conf and /etc/systemd/user.conf. The memory budget (--memory_bytes) must fit the GPU's GTT, half of RAM by default (/sys/class/drm/card*/device/mem_info_gtt_total).

gfx1150.name: AMD Radeon 890M (gfx1150)
gfx1150.note: bw MEASURED: 96 GB/s streaming copy (256 MiB in + 256 MiB out, vector<4xf32>, gfx11-generic; time of 8 extra back-to-back launches, 2 runs: 96.2 / 95.2) on an HP OmniBook Ultra 14 (Ryzen AI 9 HX 375, LPDDR5X-7500 128-bit = 120 GB/s peak: 80 %), hrx-loom 0.2.0, 2026-11-16. Bandwidth is per laptop (a DDR5-5600 SODIMM model has 89.6 GB/s peak). flops SPEC: 16 CUs x 512 x 2.9 GHz = 23.8 TFLOP/s dense f16 WMMA

runner.note: no DevLab runner: results come from a named machine (fleet/devices/gfx1150.json, provenance per session)
